description: This Java class defines a Fragment named LogFragment used in Android development. It manages a custom LogView to display log data, setting up its layout, styling, and handling text change events to auto-scroll. The class provides methods to inflate its views and retrieve the LogView component.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays logs via a custom LogView, handles view layout, and manages auto-scrolling on text updates.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styling, padding, and gravity. Adds the LogView to the ScrollView and returns it.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy by calling inflateViews, sets a TextWatcher on LogView to auto-scroll on text changes, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Provides access to the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
